Affine noise dependence gives the exact noise stability boundaries. Equality is only marginal; no spatial or nonlinear claims are made.

value.rationale: A physically meaningful modeling choice in a recent seven-site active-matter description—random versus incumbent-preserving resolution of tied local plurality—changes whether any positive density threshold is required for spontaneous amplification at zero noise. The theorem provides exact, opposite sign regimes, an algebraic root and a quadratic low-density noise scale. This is a motivated sensitivity boundary for interpreting majority alignment, and the claim remains valuable without asserting a complete spatial phase diagram.
